verdict.rationale: Medusa hosts an official, first-party Streamable HTTP MCP server at docs.medusajs.com/mcp that MCP-capable agents such as Cursor can connect to, and a probe confirms the documentation page exists. However, its documented scope is limited to searching Medusa documentation, and the pricing page's "Medusa MCP" for Cloud is not described further. Missing for 10: documented MCP tools for operating commerce data or the store backend, details of the Cloud "Medusa MCP" offering, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Medusa hosts a Streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://docs.medusajs.com/mcp` that you can add to AI agents supporting MCP server connections.
The Medusa documentation provides a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows you to find information from the Medusa documentation right in your IDEs or AI tools, such as Cursor.
